name: Xu Yang (Fatbobman)
bio:
Xu Yang shares his development expertise in Swift, SwiftUI, and Apple platform technologies through his blog Fatbobman.com. As the creator of Fatbobman's Swift Weekly, he curates outstanding articles from developers worldwide, bringing valuable insights to the Swift community.

He views Swift development as a passion in life and aims to spread the joy he finds in learning and creating to more developers.✨
